CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_save_request_work()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select (private.current_active_profile()).id is not null
     and (
       lower(btrim((private.current_active_profile()).username)) in
         ('dylan_collyge', 'jd_jones', 'megan_kelly', 'kayla_knepp')
       or private.normalized_profile_role((private.current_active_profile()).role) not like 'QC%'
     )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_work_request_identity(creator_username text, selected_rep_username text, requested_by_value text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with actor as (
    select
      lower(btrim(coalesce((private.current_active_profile()).username, ''))) as username_key,
      regexp_replace(split_part(lower(coalesce((private.current_active_profile()).username, '')), '@', 1), '[^a-z0-9]+', '', 'g') as identity_key
  )
  select (private.current_active_profile()).id is not null
     and (
       (select username_key from actor) not in ('ben_brown', 'chance_alldredge')
       or (
         (select identity_key from actor) <> ''
         and (select identity_key from actor) in (
           regexp_replace(split_part(lower(coalesce(creator_username, '')), '@', 1), '[^a-z0-9]+', '', 'g'),
           regexp_replace(split_part(lower(coalesce(selected_rep_username, '')), '@', 1), '[^a-z0-9]+', '', 'g'),
           regexp_replace(split_part(lower(coalesce(requested_by_value, '')), '@', 1), '[^a-z0-9]+', '', 'g')
         )
       )
     )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.inventory_row_assigned_to_actor_v2392(p_actor_username text, p_master_uid text, p_itemcode text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.ph_master_inventory m
    WHERE m.unique_id = btrim(p_master_uid) AND upper(btrim(m.itemcode)) = upper(btrim(p_itemcode))
      AND private.normalize_inventory_live_change_username_v2392(p_actor_username) <> ''
      AND private.normalize_inventory_live_change_username_v2392(p_actor_username) = coalesce(
        (SELECT nullif(private.normalize_inventory_live_change_username_v2392(o.assignedto),'') FROM public.ph_itemcode_default_owners o
         WHERE o.itemcode_normalized = upper(btrim(m.itemcode))),
        (SELECT private.normalize_inventory_live_change_username_v2392(o.assignedto) AS owner FROM public.ph_itemcode_default_owners o
         WHERE left(m.itemcode,6) ~ '^[0-9]{6}$' AND o.itemcode_normalized >= left(m.itemcode,6)||'.'
           AND o.itemcode_normalized < left(m.itemcode,6)||'/' AND nullif(btrim(o.assignedto),'') IS NOT NULL
         GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC, owner LIMIT 1),
        nullif(private.normalize_inventory_live_change_username_v2392(m.eval_user),''),
        nullif(private.normalize_inventory_live_change_username_v2392(m.default_owner),''),
        nullif(private.normalize_inventory_live_change_username_v2392(m.effective_worker),''),
        nullif(private.normalize_inventory_live_change_username_v2392(m.assignedto),''))
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.inventory_unrestricted_actor_v23155(p_actor profiles)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT p_actor.id IS NOT NULL AND p_actor.disabled_at IS NULL AND p_actor.must_change_password IS FALSE
    AND (p_actor.locked_until IS NULL OR p_actor.locked_until <= statement_timestamp())
    AND (private.normalized_profile_role(p_actor.role) IN ('SUPERADMIN','ADMIN','ADMINISTRATOR')
      OR private.normalize_inventory_live_change_username_v2392(p_actor.username) IN ('dylan_collyge','megan_kelly','jd_jones','mitch_kaiser','nelly_aguilar','morgan_anderson')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_access u WHERE u.profile_id = p_actor.id AND u.edit_any_row = 'Y'));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.normalize_inventory_live_change_username_v2392(p_value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case regexp_replace(lower(btrim(coalesce(p_value,''))),'[^a-z0-9]+','_','g')
    when 'nally_aguilar' then 'nelly_aguilar' when 'charlie_robertson' then 'charley_robertson' when 'kayla_knapp' then 'kayla_knepp' when 'abigail_vasquez' then 'abigail_vazquez' when 'jorge' then 'jorge_colunga'
    when 'colunga_jorge' then 'jorge_colunga'
    else regexp_replace(lower(btrim(coalesce(p_value,''))),'[^a-z0-9]+','_','g') end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.normalized_profile_role(p_role text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select upper(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_role, ''), '[^A-Za-z0-9]+', '', 'g'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_service_role_request()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), ''),
    auth.jwt()->>'role',
    ''
  ) = 'service_role'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_profile()
 RETURNS profiles
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p.*
  from public.profiles p
  where p.id = auth.uid()
    and p.disabled_at is null
    and (p.locked_until is null or p.locked_until <= now())
  limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_active_profile()
 RETURNS profiles
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p
  from public.profiles p
  where p.id = (select auth.uid())
    and p.disabled_at is null
    and (p.locked_until is null or p.locked_until <= statement_timestamp())
    and (p.legacy_user_id is null or exists (
      select 1 from public.ph_app_users u
      where u.id=p.legacy_user_id and lower(btrim(u.username))=lower(btrim(p.username))
        and u.disabled_at is null and (u.locked_until is null or u.locked_until<=statement_timestamp())
    ))
    and not private.scheduled_handover_cutoff_reached_v1(p.username,statement_timestamp())
  limit 1
$function$
